description: This file defines a benchmark class for testing different grain storage backends in an Orleans-based application. It includes setup methods for various storage configurations, a run method to execute the benchmarks asynchronously, and internal configurator classes for each storage type.

classes.name: GrainStorageBenchmark
classes.description: A class to benchmark different Orleans grain storage providers by measuring read/write operations and performance metrics.

classes.name: SiloMemoryStorageConfigurator
classes.description: Configures an Orleans silo to use in-memory grain storage.

classes.name: SiloAzureTableStorageConfigurator
classes.description: Configures an Orleans silo to use Azure Table storage for grains.

classes.name: SiloAzureBlobStorageConfigurator
classes.description: Configures an Orleans silo to use Azure Blob storage for grains.

classes.name: SiloAdoNetStorageConfigurator
classes.description: Configures an Orleans silo to use ADO.NET storage for grains.

methods.name: MemorySetup
methods.description: Sets up the test cluster with in-memory storage.

methods.name: AzureTableSetup
methods.description: Sets up the test cluster with Azure Table storage.

methods.name: AzureBlobSetup
methods.description: Sets up the test cluster with Azure Blob storage.

methods.name: AdoNetSetup
methods.description: Sets up the test cluster with ADO.NET storage.

methods.name: RunAsync
methods.description: Executes the benchmark asynchronously, measuring performance over a specified duration.

methods.name: RunAsync (overload)
methods.description: Runs a benchmark iteration for a specific grain instance until the running flag is false.

methods.name: Teardown
methods.description: Stops all silos in the test cluster.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the test cluster resources.
